rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese term for a sidewalk.

example.english: Be careful, there’s a bicycle on the sidewalk.
example.traditional: 小心啲，行人路有架單車。
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 hang4 jan4 lou6 jau5 gaa3 daan1 ce1

rows.note: Speakers use this more formal or written term, especially on signs and in official contexts.

example.english: Please proceed along the sidewalk to the bus stop.
example.traditional: 請沿行人徑前往巴士站。
example.jyutping: cing2 jyun4 hang4 jan4 ging3 cin4 wong5 baa1 si6 zaam6
